review_candidates.title: Senior IT Network Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Reporting to the Global IT Director, this is a hands-on role with primary responsibility for the design, implementation, operation, reliability, and lifecycle management of the corporate network. The role includes responsibility for corporate routing, firewalls, VPN and remote access, office-to-office connectivity, DNS, wireless networking, network authentication, and related network infrastructure. Role & Responsibilities Own the architecture, implementation, operation, and reliability of Spire
eligibility_evidence: Experience supporting geographically distributed offices and hybrid cloud environments.
Spire operates a hybrid work model, and this position will require you to work a minimum of three days per week in the office.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Reporting to the Global IT Director, this is a hands-on role with primary responsibility for the design, implementation, operation, reliability, and lifecycle management of the corporate network. Partner closely with Security on network-security architecture, firewall policy, segmentation, secure-access requirements, PKI, and other security controls. Basic Qualifications 5+ years of experience in network engineering, network operations, infrastructure engineering, or a similar hands-on technical role. Hands-on experience designing, operating , and troubleshooting enterprise routing and switching environments. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Palo Alto Networks firewalls or similar enterprise firewall platforms. Experience supporting environments with security, regulatory, or compliance requirements.
